question: Does the unchanged orbit-prefix map applied to a source-admissible nested anchored geometry family transport one fixed invariant observable with volume-independent finite support?
authorization: DCTRL-000027 permits one support/extension design or exact obstruction. This is a new explicit test family inside the parent's finite carrier class, not adoption as G_(h,N), a substitute finite dynamics, or a physical geometry.

family.vertices: 0,1,2 and L_k=2k+1,R_k=2k+2 for 1<=k<=d; ordered by these integer labels
family.faces: One unchanged oriented closed triangle [(0,+1),(1,+1),(2,+1)] in stored edge indices
family.anchors: O={0}, C={1,2} at every d, labels only
family.boundary: Open arm endpoints; no fixed fields, extra face, periodic closure, or terminal conditioning
family.inclusions: Literal inclusions G_d into G_(d+1), preserving O,C and the triangle. No state comparison across d is assumed.
family.source_admissibility: Connected finite oriented two-cell complex, nonempty closed face, distinct oriented geometric edges, maximum degree 3 uniformly in d; no physical metric/volume
family.symmetry: Complete H has identity and simultaneous arm/triangle reflection tau: 1<->2,L_k<->R_k; base edge (1,2) reverses sign. Gauge group unchanged.

regulators.coarse: The existing first B pair: K=2,Ms=Mpsi=Q=1; Rmax>0 and all real parameters fixed.
regulators.fine: K=4,Ms=2,Mpsi=4,Q=2; Rmax doubled as in B, not evaluated.
regulators.order: No limit taken. The quantified graph-size statement at this fixed cutoff is not a reversal of source local-cutoff-before-geometry limit order.

fixed_observable: f=(-1)^(u_(1,2)+n_1-n_2 mod 2) on the same coarse base edge at every d. Full gauge/anchor invariant, support S={vertices 1,2;edge (1,2)}.

two_states.common: Fine ell_0=2; all other ell and all n zero; u_(1,2)=1, all other u zero. All aperture indices zero except one remote terminal index.
two_states.claim_to_test: For arbitrary d, the two states agree within every ball of combinatorial radius R<d around S but the actual orbit-prefix pullback takes opposite +/-1 values.

preregistered_tests.algorithm: Apply the exact pinned map, including whole-G canonicalization, signed inverse frame and original phase rule. Do not replace it with an improved quantizer.
preregistered_tests.fixed_support: Prove using the arbitrary-d family, not a table extrapolation, that no one finite subset of the infinite two-arm graph determines all these pullbacks for sufficiently large d.
preregistered_tests.sup_norm: For any local approximation h_d determined by a fixed finite support, test the two-point bound ||If-h_d||_infinity>=|If(A)-If(B)|/2 at sufficiently large d. No Gibbs probability estimate.
preregistered_tests.smoke_role: One executable instance validates indexing and exact map application; arbitrary-d conclusion comes from the written proof. No state-space enumeration or scale sweep.
preregistered_tests.independent: No primary/map/enumerator imports; reconstruct reflection from degree/distance classes and use direct integer reflection/coarsening. Same-task authorship.
preregistered_tests.hostile: Retain all signed edges and hidden aperture labels; ensure f is fixed and fully invariant; never infer all-family impossibility, generator failure, Gibbs-L2 failure or ordered-limit failure.

non_claims: No new model, root, rate, state normalization, projection or time rule
No Gibbs-L2, generator or ordered-limit conclusion
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum or TOE
